name: Expert Panel Knowledge Base
description: Curated link catalog of stable knowledge sources. Experts consult matching entries before inventing sources. Links are pointers, not cached content. Prefer live verification when tools allow.
usage: Match task domain/tags to entries before first-pass claim cards
Cite entry id (KB-xxx) in evidence ledger when a link was used as a starting point
Never treat a catalog link as proof that a claim is true without reading or verifying the target
Prefer primary/official sources over secondary summaries
If web access is unavailable, still use catalog titles/notes as research direction and mark freshness UNKNOWN
